title: 5G NR LDPC base graphs and per-i_LS shift tables (BG1+BG2, key rates)
description:
## Goal

Land the 3GPP TS 38.212 LDPC base graphs (BG1, BG2) and the
per-`i_LS` shift tables for all 8 lifting sets, covering rates
{1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6}. Verified bit-exact vs reference test
vectors.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR LDPC real-time and research
enablers) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Per-`i_LS`
correctness is a known trap recorded in agent memory — single
lifting-set tables cause ~2 dB BLER loss; the per-`i_LS` indexing
must be honoured. Placeholder body — project-lead expands during
claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] BG1 and BG2 base graphs + per-`i_LS` shift tables for
  all 8 lifting sets and rates {1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6} verified
  bit-exact against 3GPP TS 38.212 reference test vectors;
  per-`i_LS` indexing tested explicitly.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
